caption_L1: This is a bar plot titled Total demand for electricity in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2000 to 2019 (in gigawatt hours). There is a categorical scale starting at 2000 and ending at 2019* along the y-axis, labeled Year. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 400,000 can be found along the x-axis, marked Demand in gigawatt hours.
caption_L2L3: The amount of demand for electricity has decreased in the UK, as the beginning of the 2000s had the highest amount of demand, peaking in 2005, before decreasing from 2006 to an all time low in 2019.
